panels.general_description: Infographic summarizing a retrospective case series of 21 patients, with a methods list and four result boxes.
panels.detailed_description: A wide infographic with a dark blue title banner at the top: a journal logo block at the left and the white title text Biopsy-proven tyrosine kinase inhibitor-associated kidney injury: a case series. A light blue band beneath reads that the study characterizes the clinicopathological spectrum and outcomes of biopsy-proven tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) associated nephrotoxicity. The left column is headed Methods and lists four icon-and-text rows: a magnifier over a book with Retrospective case series (n=21); a kidney with a needle with Biopsy-proven TKI-associated renal injury; a target with Stratification by TKI class/molecular target; a calendar with Clinical follow-up: median 9.5 months. The right panel is headed Results and holds four white boxes in a two-by-two grid: a microscope slide icon with Kidney-limited thrombotic microangiopathy (TMA) and 80%; a pill bottle icon with Drug discontinuation or substitution and 72%; a urine cup icon with Proteinuria remission (partial or complete) and 55%; a test tube icon with Stable S-creatinine in patients alive at follow-up and 100%. A dark blue banner along the bottom carries the white conclusion text that TKI-associated kidney injury presents with oedema, hypertension, and proteinuria, that kidney-limited TMA is the predominant histological finding, and that patients have preserved kidney function after timely drug discontinuation; a light panel at the lower right holds author, journal and year credit text and contact handles.
